_comment: Copy this file, rename it 2026-MM-DD-short-name.json, and fill it in. Files starting with an underscore are ignored by the build.
_type_options: record | decision | consultation | presentation | participant | related-party | withholding | review | certification
title: A short title, one line
body: One paragraph per line in this list.
reasons: Optional. Clause 10.2B requires the reasons for every decision applying the Trust Fund.
_consultation_only: The three fields below apply to type: consultation and are ignored otherwise.
prompt: The prompt exactly as put, verbatim. Clause 9.3 requires it recorded verbatim and published before responses are collected.

responses.version: Version or identifier, so far as ascertainable
responses.system_prompt: Any system prompt or instruction in effect, in full. Say 'none' if none.
responses.response: The response in full, unedited, unsummarised. Clause 9.4.
